culprit_citations.quoted_text: Industry | Issuer | Acquisition Date | Investment | % of Net Assets | Par Amount | Maturity Date | Amortized Cost | Fair Value

rationale: FX01 flags non-USD debt principal rows missing principal_amount_usd, but the raw schedule for the flagged debt positions is a dollar-denominated Par Amount / Amortized Cost / Fair Value table. The first debt row explicitly carries dollar signs in the par, cost, and fair value columns, and the debt total ties the same schedule without any foreign-currency marker. A targeted source query for foreign currency/par/dollars returned no foreign-currency hits. The non-USD premise is therefore not supported by raw source.
